diagnostics.message: `local_file.public_ssh_key` has an explicit `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content = "${tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh}"` already establishes that dependency implicitly, so the explicit depends_on is redundant.

`local_file.private_ssh_key` has an explicit `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content = "${tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem}"` already establishes that dependency implicitly, so the explicit depends_on is redundant.

`aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token` is documented in-source as having its value written by the gitlab runner instance's user-data (with `ignore_changes` on `value`). The parameter must exist before the instance boots, otherwise the instance's write is later clobbered by this resource's `value = "null"`. `aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` builds that user-data but reaches the parameter only via locals (no attribute reference, no depends_on), so no ordering is enforced. It should depend on the SSM parameter.
